questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
이것은 100년 전에 우리 할아버지에 의해 지어진 집이다.
This is the house that ____ by my grandfather 100 years ago.
o: was built
built
was build
is built
has built
questions.e: 관계대명사절 안에서도 수동태는 be + p.p.예요. 100 years ago가 있어서 과거 was built를 써요. built만 쓰면 능동이 되어 '집이 지었다'는 뜻이 돼요.

questions.q:
다음 문장을 수동태로 바르게 바꾼 것을 고르세요.
Ms. Kim taught us English last year.
o: We were taught English by Ms. Kim last year.
We were taught English to Ms. Kim last year.
English was taught us by Ms. Kim last year.
We are taught English by Ms. Kim last year.
Us were taught English by Ms. Kim last year.
questions.e: 4형식 문장은 간접목적어 us를 주어 We로 올리고 were taught를 써요. 직접목적어 English를 주어로 하면 English was taught to us처럼 to가 필요해요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
Jeju is known ____ its beaches, and the island is covered ____ beautiful flowers in spring.
questions.ko: 제주는 해변으로 유명하고, 그 섬은 봄에 아름다운 꽃들로 덮인다.
o: for – with
with – for
by – with
for – by
of – with
questions.e: be known for는 '~로 유명하다', be covered with는 '~로 덮여 있다'예요. 이런 표현은 by 대신 정해진 전치사를 써요.
questions.ref: 5. by 대신 다른 전치사를 쓰는 표현 (암기)

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르세요.
o: The old man was made to leave the room by the guard.
The accident was happened when he was crossing the street.
A new bike was bought me by my dad last week.
The window was broke by the boy who lives next door.
He is called Tom by everyone who know him.
questions.e: 사역동사 make의 수동태는 동사원형이 to부정사로 바뀌어 was made to leave가 돼요. happen은 수동태로 쓸 수 없고, buy는 for me가 필요하고, broke는 p.p. broken으로, who know는 선행사 everyone에 맞춰 knows로 써야 해요.

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
그 문제는 내일 회의가 시작되기 전에 해결되어야 한다.
The problem ____ before the meeting starts tomorrow.
o: must be solved
must solve
must be solve
must solved
must is solved
questions.e: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 조동사 + be + p.p.예요. must solve는 능동이라 '문제가 해결한다'는 뜻이 되고, be 뒤에는 p.p. solved가 와야 해요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
A: When ____ the first telephone ____?
B: It was invented in 1876, and many people were surprised at the news.
o: was – invented
did – invent
was – invent
is – invented
were – invented
questions.e: 의문사가 있는 수동태 의문문은 의문사 + be동사 + 주어 + p.p. ~? 순서예요. 주어 the first telephone이 단수이고 과거라서 was ~ invented예요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: The letters that were written by my grandfather is kept in this box.
The boy was surprised at the news that his team won.
English and French are spoken in Canada.
Was the cake made for you by your sister?
The bridge will not be built until next year.
questions.e: 문장의 주어는 The letters(복수)라서 be동사는 are를 써야 해요. 관계대명사절 끝의 grandfather에 속지 않도록 주의해요. → The letters that were written by my grandfather are kept in this box.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: She was made clean the room by her mother.
The festival is held every autumn in our town.
The present was given to me by my best friend.
Cheese is made from milk, and this table is made of wood.
The question can't be answered in one word.
questions.e: 사역동사 make의 수동태에서는 동사원형이 to부정사로 바뀌어요. → She was made to clean the room by her mother.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: My cat was disappeared yesterday, and it hasn't come back yet.
He is called the king of pop by many fans.
Was this poem written by a middle school student?
The room is filled with beautiful flowers.
I was told the news by my teacher this morning.
questions.e: disappear는 목적어가 없는 동사라서 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요. → My cat disappeared yesterday, and it hasn't come back yet.

questions.q:
능동태 문장을 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (두 단어)
My uncle built this house in 2010.
→ This house ____ by my uncle in 2010.
questions.ko: 이 집은 2010년에 우리 삼촌에 의해 지어졌다.
questions.e: 목적어 this house를 주어로 올리고 동사를 be + p.p.로 바꿔요. 과거이고 주어가 단수라서 was built예요.

questions.q:
능동태 문장을 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (다섯 단어)
The teacher made the students stand up.
→ The students ____ by the teacher.
questions.e: 사역동사 make의 수동태는 be made + to부정사예요. 주어 the students가 복수이고 과거라서 were made to stand up이에요.

questions.q:
괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (전치사 포함 세 단어)
I ____ the result of the game because I didn't expect it. (surprise)
questions.ko: 나는 예상하지 못했기 때문에 경기 결과에 놀랐다.
questions.e: '~에 놀라다'는 be surprised at으로 쓰고, by를 쓰지 않아요. didn't가 있어서 과거 was예요.
questions.ref: 5. by 대신 다른 전치사를 쓰는 표현 (암기)

questions.q: The movie that was directed by him was watching by millions of people.
questions.ko: 그가 감독한 그 영화는 수백만 명의 사람들에게 시청되었다.
questions.e: '시청되었다'는 수동태라서 be + p.p.인 was watched를 써야 해요. was watching은 진행형으로 '보고 있었다'는 능동의 뜻이에요.

questions.q: A cake was made to me by my grandmother on my birthday.
questions.ko: 내 생일에 할머니께서 나에게 케이크를 만들어 주셨다.
questions.e: make, buy, cook처럼 for를 쓰는 동사는 직접목적어를 주어로 한 수동태에서 for를 써요. → A cake was made for me ~.

questions.q: The rules must are followed by everyone who joins the club.
questions.ko: 그 규칙들은 동아리에 가입하는 모든 사람에 의해 지켜져야 한다.
questions.e: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 조동사 + be + p.p.예요. 조동사 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 are가 아니라 be를 써요.

questions.ko: 그 창문은 어젯밤에 옆집에 사는 소년에 의해 깨졌다.
ans: The window was broken last night by the boy who lives next door.
The window was broken by the boy who lives next door last night.
questions.e: 과거 수동태 was broken 뒤에 by + 행위자를 쓰고, 행위자 the boy를 관계대명사절 who lives next door가 꾸며요.

questions.ko: 이 편지들은 네가 서울로 떠나기 전에 보내져야 한다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: These letters should be sent before you leave for Seoul.
questions.e: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 조동사 + be + p.p.라서 should be sent로 써요. send의 과거분사는 sent예요.

questions.ko: 나는 작년에 삼촌에게서 새 자전거를 받았다. (수동태로, I를 주어로)
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: I was given a new bike by my uncle last year.
Last year I was given a new bike by my uncle.
questions.e: 4형식 동사 give의 수동태에서 간접목적어 I를 주어로 하면 was given + 직접목적어 순서예요. last year가 있어서 과거 was를 써요.
